inputs.doc: E-026 EVAL wave 1: rolled corridor AUC for the REACH axis — spiral-24@4444 x3 and three-rings-wide@1000 x3 against the e017 gate and the e023r222 champion reference. These are the completed 4444km and 1000km arms; wave 2 (sunflower, elliptic, spiral-34, plus the remaining 1000km factorial: two-ring/narrow/sp13/sp8/ring16) follows when their third seeds land — stated here so the split is on the record, no silent caps. Decision rule pre-committed by Chris: rank by corridor AUC, paired by seed (the seed-index effect); if the sunflower CI overlaps the leader, the sunflower is the chosen arrangement.
